s's resource is mutably borrowed by r; s can't be used while the borrow is live
s's resource is no longer mutably borrowed

g.data-tooltip-text:
• s's resource is immutably borrowed by println!; s is read-only while the borrow is live
• println! reads from s through an implicit reference, so s isn't moved
• s's resource is no longer immutably borrowed
s goes out of scope. Its resource is dropped.

polygon.style: fill: var(--rv-drop-notch); stroke: none; pointer-events: none;

circle.data-tooltip-text: r mutably borrows a resource

t acquires ownership of a resource
t is live in a conditional expression
t's resource is captured (moved) by closure g
t was moved in at least one branch above, so it can't be used after the branches. If the branch that ran didn't move it, its resource is dropped when t goes out of scope.

g.data-tooltip-text: t goes out of scope. Its resource is dropped here only if no branch above moved it (Rust tracks this with a runtime drop flag).
